summary:
Constellation 本季 EPS 超預期5.3%，營收年增64%，核電與資料中心電力需求爆發。
• EPS 2.74 美元，較預估2.60超出5.30%。
• 營收11.12億美元（B級），年增63.85%爆發成長。
• 核電作為穩定無碳基載，受惠 AI 資料中心電力需求。
• 與科技巨頭的電力購售協議（PPA）提供長期能見度。
ai_view:
訊號強正面：EPS 超預期且營收年增近64%，反映 AI 資料中心對穩定無碳電力的結構性需求，Constellation 作為美國最大核電業者直接受惠。短期股價受 AI 電力主題強力驅動，中期關鍵在新增 PPA 簽訂與核電產能擴充（包括 SMR 與既有機組延役）。追蹤指標：與科技巨頭 PPA 進度、核電容量因子、電價避險部位與每股盈餘指引。22.9倍本益比對成長動能而言不算貴。

需留意：電力批發價格波動影響營收與利潤。；核電廠營運與監管風險，停機事件衝擊發電量。；本益比22.89，需資料中心需求持續兌現支撐成長。

summary_en:
Constellation beat EPS by 5.3% with 64% revenue growth, on surging nuclear and data-center power demand.
• EPS of $2.74 beat the $2.60 estimate by 5.30%.
• Revenue of $11.12B surged 63.85% year over year.
• Nuclear as stable carbon-free baseload benefits from AI data-center demand.
• Power purchase agreements with tech giants provide long-term visibility.

ai_view_en:
Signal is strongly positive: an EPS beat with ~64% revenue growth reflects structural AI data-center demand for stable carbon-free power, directly benefiting Constellation as the largest US nuclear operator. Near-term the stock is powered by the AI-power theme; mid-term hinges on new PPA signings and nuclear capacity expansion (SMRs and plant-life extensions). Track PPA progress with tech giants, nuclear capacity factors, power-price hedges, and EPS guidance. A 22.9x P/E is not expensive given the growth momentum.

Watch：Wholesale power price volatility affects revenue and profit.; Nuclear operating and regulatory risk; outages hit generation.; A P/E of 22.89 needs data-center demand to keep materializing.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出5.30%，營收年增高達63.85%動能驚人。
